tiles: truth/tiles/superworld-comics-001/p020 (3 x 5, 15% overlap, native resolution; high-resolution scan)
bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
excluded: A tiny printed line in the right gutter of the explosion panel (vertical, under 12 px, unreadable) and the small-print body text of the newspaper (illegible lines).
page_notes: 1940 lettering: hand-drawn italic upper case with idiosyncratic apostrophes (drawn as tick marks above the letters, e.g. LET'S, YOU'VE, NEEDN'T). Story title in large display type. Includes a two-part newspaper headline partly hidden by a hand and the panel edge, and a large BOOM! sound effect.

regions.notes: Red outlined block letters (BUZZ ALLEN), a black italic lower-case 'the', and black block INVISIBLE / AVENGER! on two lines, all on a yellow banner. The lower case of 'the' is as printed.

regions.text: WE'RE FALLING! LET'S GET OUT OF HERE!

regions.notes: Small boxed caption, upright letters, three lines, dark on a pale orange halftone.
Large green outlined display letters set on a diagonal over a yellow and red explosion.

regions.text: WHY LOOK SO GLUM? YOU'VE DESTROYED YATES AND HIS HIDEOUT-
regions.notes: Lettered 'DES-' / 'TROYED' across a line break; written as the whole word. The apostrophe in YOU'VE is drawn as a tick over the U-V. Ends with a single dash.

regions.text: YES, BUT HIS GANG ESCAPED! I CAN'T REST UNTIL I BRING THEM TO JUSTICE
regions.notes: No end punctuation. The '!' after ESCAPED is drawn as a short slanted stroke with a dot.

regions.text: WELL, BUZZ, OL' BOY-YOU NEEDN'T WORRY ABOUT YATES' HENCHMEN ANY MORE. SEE THAT HEADLINE? WE MUST HAVE SCARED THEM OFF BEFORE THEY COULD REFUEL
regions.notes: 'HEAD-' / 'LINE?' and 'BE-' / 'FORE' are broken across lines; written as whole words. 'BOY-YOU' is a single dash joining two words, kept as drawn. No end punctuation after REFUEL.
Newspaper masthead, tilted and partly smudged; letters about 30 px tall. Reading fairly certain.

Newspaper headline on two lines. The final letters (CRASH, KILLED) and possibly a character before '5' are hidden behind the reader's head and hand; only the visible letters are transcribed. The intended headline is clearly 'PLANE CRASH / 5 MEN KILLED'.

regions.text: I PLEDGE MY LIFE TO HELP DESTROY ORGANIZED CRIME WITH THIS GREAT POWER THAT GOD HAS GIVEN ME!
COUNT ME IN ON THAT, BUZZ! AND THIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNING!
